programme.title: A gyanú árnyékában
programme.desc: S01E95 Fanni és Gábor a kertvárosban élnek a gyermekeikkel, a 12 éves Lukáccsal és a 10 éves Klárával. Mióta a boltvezető Fanni és a karosszérialakatos Gábor néhány hónapja munkanélküliek lettek, egyre nehezebb anyagi helyzetbe kerültek. Nem tudják tovább fizetni a hitelük törlesztő részleteit a bank felé. Hogy elkerüljék a ház elárverezését, Fanni szülei megígérték a családnak, hogy segítenek és adnak nekik pénzt. De amikor elérkezik a fizetés ideje a két nyugdíjas, különböző okok miatt lemondja az utalást. Fanni és Gábor még akkor sem kapják meg a beígért összeget a nagyszülőktől, amikor a bank kiküldi az utolsó felszólítást. Az anya kétségbe van esve, hogy nemsokára az utcára kerül a családjával. Nem érti, hogy a szülei miért nem segítenek, ahogy megígérték. Fanni először arra gyanakszik, hogy a pazarló öccse kapta meg az ő részét is. De a valóság sokkal drámaibb.

programme.title: A gyanú árnyékában
programme.desc: S01E96 A 16 éves Dóra a szüleivel és öccsével, Rolanddal él Budaörsön. Anyja, Kati félállásban dolgozik a család számítástechnikai szaküzletében, férje, Vilmos könyvelését igazgatja. Kettejük házassága az évek alatt teljesen ellaposodott. Vilmos már tudomást sem vesz feleségéről, szabadidejében inkább a kanapén lustálkodik, ezért Kati sok időt tölt egyedül. Kati, hogy feldobja életét, hetente többször felkeresi egy fitneszstúdiót. Dóra elirigyli anyja sportos alakját, és szeretne vele tartani. De amikor egyik este belép a stúdióba, rajtakapja Katit, amint hevesen csókolózik egy fiatal fitness edzővel, Szabolccsal. Kati tagadja, hogy viszonya lenne, de amikor Vilmos megfeledkezik Kati születésnapjáról, a csalódott feleség rádöbben, hogy ez így nem mehet tovább. Hosszas gyötrődés után végül felvállalja Szabolcsot, és otthagyja Vilmost. A család fel van háborodva, amikor a családanya anyagilag is támogatni akarja fiatal barátját. Különösen Dóra nem hisz benne, hogy Szabolcsnak...

programme.title: A gyanú árnyékában
programme.desc: S01E97 A 25 éves Hajdú Noémit sokként éri, amikor egy rutinvizsgálat során a nőgyógyászától megtudja, hogy terhes. Az életvidám, bulizásra mindig kapható lány ugyanis egyáltalán nincs felkészülve arra, hogy gyereket vállaljon. Sőt még azt sem tudja, hogy ki lehet a gyereke apja azok közül, akikkel együtt volt. Három lehetséges jelölt van, akik közül azonban csak egy válna szívesen apává. A szomszéd, Márk; az egyéjszakás kaland, Szabolcs; és a volt főnöke, Mátyás. A háromból két férfi, még csak tudomást sem akar venni egy lehetséges apaságról, nem hajlandók belemenni egy apasági tesztbe vagy bármilyen módon segíteni Noéminek. Noémi ezért elhatározza, hogy a férfiak akarata ellenére is kideríti, hogy ki lehet a születendő gyermekének az apja.

programme.title: New Amsterdam - Vészhelyzet New Yorkban
programme.desc: S05E06 Iggy próbálja újra felépíteni magát, hogy kiderítse, hogy mit is akar igazából. Casey visszatér a sürgősségire. Max és Wilder reggeli futás közben segít egy balesetet szenvedett idős hölgynek és az unokájának. Max küzdeni kezd a környék közlekedésének biztonságosabbá tételéért, a fiú pedig nehéz döntésre kényszerül a nagymamája műtétjét illetően. Iggy egy nyughatatlan kisfiút kezel, aki elvesztette a hallását...

programme.title: New Amsterdam - Vészhelyzet New Yorkban
programme.desc: S05E07 A kórház személyzete megdöbbenve fogadja a legfelsőbb bíróság döntését a Roe kontra Wade-ügyben. Wilder méhnyakrákos beteget kezel. Max próbál megoldást találni az abortuszra vágyó nők számára. Iggy a kórház előtti tüntetés soraiba keveredve egy nő védelmére kel, aki ellen egy férfi hergeli a tömeget. Bloom és Reynolds egy orvoslás iránt érdeklődő diákcsoportot vezet végig a kórházon, közben fény derül valamire közös múltjukból...

programme.title: CSI: A helyszínelők
programme.desc: S12E21 A csapatot ezúttal egy váratlanul működésbe lépett bombához riasztják, mely verseny közben robbant fel, megölve ezzel az egyik versenyzőt.

programme.title: CSI: A helyszínelők
programme.desc: S12E22 A helyszínelők csapata három holttest ügyében nyomoz, amiket néhány háztömbnyire találtak egy kampány vacsora helyszínétől. Miután körvonalazódni látszik a gyilkos személye, egy megrázó felfedezést tesznek.

programme.title: CSI: A helyszínelők
programme.desc: S14E01 Egy újabb női holttest kerül elő, akit Dante művének, a Pokol 5. körének díszletei között találnak meg. Az áldozat nagy valószínűséggel az egyik egyházi gyülekezetből származik. Russell és Julie tudja, hogy az idejük vészesen fogy, és hamarosan az eltűnt lányok egyike, Morgan vagy Ellie következik a sorozatgyilkos listáján. Ecklie képtelen megbirkózni azzal, hogy a lánya lehet a Pokol következő helyszínének a főszereplője.

programme.title: CSI: A helyszínelők

programme.title: CSI: A helyszínelők
programme.desc: S14E02 A felkapott, nagy tétekkel játszó Texas Hold-em játékteremből elrabolnak több mint egymillió dollár nyereményt. A motoros elkövető ámokfutásba kezd Las Vegas utcáin, de nem éli túl a menekülést. A csapat megdöbbenve fedezi fel, hogy a férfi halálát nem baleset, és nem is lövés okozta, és az elrabolt pénz sincs nála. Kiderül, hogy egy bonyolult összeesküvés van a háttérben, és a rablás elkövetőjét zsarolással kényszerítették a rablásra.

programme.title: CSI: A helyszínelők
programme.desc: S14E03 Las Vegas a szerencse, a milliomosok és a fényűzés városa. Gil Grissom és csapata azonban jól ismeri a sötét oldalát. A bűnözők sokat fejlődtek és rengeteget tanultak, az utóbbi időben ravaszabbak lettek, mint valaha. A helyszínelők csak akkor vehetik fel velük a versenyt, ha naprakészek. A 14. évad A csapatot nagyon megviseli kollégájuk, Morgan és Brass nyomozó lányának az elrablása. A helyszínelők vezetője, Russell (Ted Danson), valamint Julie (Elizabeth Shue) és a csapat mindent elkövet, hogy Ecklie és Brass között helyreálljon a béke, amit az a sorozatgyilkos dúlt fel, aki Dante Poklának helyszíneit elevenítette meg a gyilkosságaiban. Ám Brass nem tudja egyedül feldolgozni saját felelősségét és lánya tettét.

programme.title: CSI: New York-i helyszínelők
programme.desc: S08E15 A helyszínelők ezúttal saját laborjuk múltjában kutatnak, miután egy esetben kapcsolatot találtak egy 1950-es évekbeli üggyel, amely segíthet kideríteni, miért öltek meg egy labortechnikust.

programme.title: CSI: New York-i helyszínelők
programme.desc: S08E14 Mac csapatának a nagyban játszó videójátékosok világában kell megtalálnia egy lehetséges gyilkost.

programme.title: Az újonc
programme.desc: S03E03 Nolan anyja váratlanul megjelenik, és beköltözik a házba. A lehető legrosszabb időben, ugyanis Grey őrmester úgy határoz, hogy az újoncoknak korábban kell letenniük a vizsgát. Nolan kis híján megbukik a lövészeten, a lőtéren megzavarja őt egy búvárruhás férfi váratlan felbukkanása. Chen csalódott, hogy kiskorú pártfogoltja, Tamara szó nélkül eladta az ajándékba kapott autóját. Jackson retteg az új kiképzőjétől, Stantontól, aki mindenhol bandákat lát, és csőre töltött fegyverrel járőrözik.

programme.title: Az újonc
programme.desc: S03E04 Grey őrmester szeretné rendbe tenni az örsöt, ahogy a kinevezésekor megfogadta, még mielőtt nyugdíjba megy. Arra kéri Jacksont, hogy vezessen naplót az új kiképzőtisztje, Stanton gyanús megnyilvánulásairól. Harper bizonyítani akar a lányának, aki szeretne bejutni a Zeneakadémiára, de a felvételiről lecsúszik. Nolan nem tudja féken tartani az anyját, aki tízezer dolláros üzletet kötött az őrmester feleségével. Bradford és Chan nyomoznak Stanton után.

programme.title: S.W.A.T. - Különleges egység
programme.desc: S06E06 Miután drámai körülmények között elrabolnak egy zsarut, aki épp egy nagyszabású drogügylet leállításának küszöbén áll, Hondo és az osztag versenyt fut az idővel, hogy megmentsék, mielőtt túl késő lenne. Luca egyre jobban aggódik Hicks megváltozott viselkedése miatt, ami már a csapatnak is feltűnik.

programme.desc: S05E07 Tom és a felesége, Sylvia biciklitúrára indul. A cukorbeteg asszonynak váratlanul inzulinra lesz szüksége. A férje segíteni akar, ám mind a ketten lezuhannak a lejtőn. programme.title: Szellemekkel suttogó
programme.desc: S01E02 Melinda egy hatéves kisfiúval találkozik egy vasúti átjárónál, aki édesanyjára vár, ezért nem akar onnan elmozdulni. Kiderül, hogy a gyermek balesetben elhunyt, amikor kocsijuk megállt a vasúti átjáróban. Melindának meg kell találnia a gyermek szüleit, hogy a fiú lelke megbékélhessen.

programme.title: Szellemekkel suttogó
programme.desc: S01E03 Ikertestvére halála után a pszichiátrián kezelnek egy tizenéves lányt. Melinda hamarosan rájön, hogy az elhunyt iker kísérti a zavartnak tűnő tinit. A távozásra váró húgnak először bocsánatot kell kérnie ikerpárjától, hogy mindketten kiszabaduljanak: egyikük a klinikáról, másikuk pedig a földi bolyongásból.

programme.title: Az újonc
programme.desc: S04E03 Nolant és Chen rendőrtisztet egy tűzesethez rendelik ki. A leégett épület láttán azt gyanítják, hogy nem baleset okozta a tűzet, hanem szándékos gyújtogatás történt. Közben szemtanúi lesznek egy lövöldözésnek, a csapat teljes erővel a lövöldöző felkutatására indul.

programme.title: Monk - Flúgos nyomozó
programme.desc: S05E14 Disher megörökölte a nagybátyja farmját, és meghívja Monkot, hogy látogassa meg. A meghívás mögött azonban más is van. Dishernek az a gyanúja, hogy a nagybátyja halála valójában nem baleset volt.

programme.title: Monk - Flúgos nyomozó
programme.desc: S05E15 Egy utcazenészt hat különböző módon ölnek meg, és a gyilkos azzal fenyegetőzik, hogy újra lecsap. A csapat azonnal beleveti magát a nyomozásban, ám Monkot és kollégáit ellenszenves FBI-ügynökök kényszerítik a háttérbe.

programme.title: Magnum
programme.desc: S02E18 Magnumot felbérelik, hogy védje meg a gazdag luxusjachtost, Jeannie Lowryt a nagy tétes pókerjátszma alatt. A játékosok között akad néhány csaló, és kiderül, hoy a tét valójában jóval nagyobb, mint ahogy a zsetonok mutatják. A jacht hamar veszélyzónává válik.

programme.title: Magnum
programme.desc: S02E19 Magnum visszatér Hawaiira, és meglepve látja, hogy a birtokon egy hollywoodi stáb forgatja éppen Robin Masters egyik regényének filmes adaptációját. Amikor a főszereplő kaszkadőre megsérül, Magnumnak kell beugrania helyette. A filmforgatás azonban sokkal veszélyesebb terep, mint gondolta.

programme.title: CSI: Miami helyszínelők
programme.desc: S09E07 Egy fiatal férfi arra készül, hogy leugrik a hídról. Brad Webb a motorcsónakjában felfigyel a férfira és azonnal a segítségére siet, hogy lebeszélje. Ám amint közelebb ér, váratlanul golyózáport kap a nyakába, és épp hogy túléli a merényletet. Horatio és csapata átvizsgálják a férfi múltját, amely makulátlannak tűnik. Akkor válik gyanússá, amikor a rendőrségen is megtámadják a férfit.

programme.title: CSI: A helyszínelők
programme.desc: S14E04 Botrányos esemény történik a népszerű főzős valóságshow egyik élő adásában. A résztvevő versenyzők elé olyan ételeket tesznek le kóstolásra, ami emberi maradványokból készült. A helyszínelők hamar megtalálják a bizonyítékokat arra, hogy az egyik kiesett versenyző maradványait használták fel. A megdöbbentő ügyben minden versenyző gyanúsítottá válik.

programme.title: CSI: A helyszínelők

Most azonban, amikor újabb holttestet találnak a házában, már sokkal könnyebb bizonyítékokat találni ellene. Russell azonban nem biztos abban, hogy a férfi a tettes, szerinte csőbe húzták.

programme.title: Az újonc

Harper folytatja a sorozatos gyújtogató felkutatását, amivel veszélybe sodorja magát. Wesley mindent elkövet, hogy védence valljon, ám a férfi hű marad a bandához.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This stage sees the strongmen visit Vaasa, Finland. Residents here are familiar with the competition because some of the SCL icons are from their country.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: 38 athletes compete in the under 90kg and under 105kg SCL World Championships. From each weight class, the top 12 qualify for the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A two day, seven event battle with lots of spectators.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Alex Moonen is leading. Part two of the competition in Romania showcases a new challenge - Hercules Hold.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this stage in Curacao no one wants to lose the chance to fight for one kilo gold in World grand finals in Dubai.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The last chance to qualify for the World Grand Finale. Zageris and Belsak fight for the better position for the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We reach Dubai where we will crown the new champion for SCL 2016. This is part one of the world finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this last episode, the best athletes compete in Pole Push, Deadlift, Forward Hold and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in beautiful Norway for the kick off of the 2017 MLO Strongman Champions League season. With partly cloudy weather and lots of snow, we have the perfect scenery for the athletes, who prepare for the first contest of the year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A definite highlight in this FIBO edition in Germany, Strongman Champions League introduced its new rules for a special team item. Graham Hicks tries here to set a New World Record on the biggest log in the world, currently held by Krzysztof Radzikowski. Boosted also by the presence of the acclaimed in the strongman circles names of Mark Felix and Danis Zageris.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This weekend sees the Strongman Champions League Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. Big lifting names such as Graham Hicks , Vidas Blekaitis and Vytatus Lalas are in the startlist to push some big numbers.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The battle of the Dutch will take place this edition in Lichtenvoorde, a place very well known in Holland because of the famous “Black Cross”. The athletes will compete over six heavy events and the winner gets 25 Strongman Champions League ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Set in the beautiful mountain resort Zlatibor, the fifth stage of the Strongman Champions League 2017 sees 14 athletes from across the world competing for the gold medal of SCL Serbia 2017. The event welcomes top-athlete - and odds-on favourite - Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia), who has presented himself in an impressive shape so far. Can his opponents defeat him?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next two stages take place in Quebec. With eight events over two days, SCL Canada is a true ‘heavyweight’. The athletes compete in: Truck Pull, Deadlift with cars, Log Lift, and the Atlas Stones. The World’s Strongest Viking Jean-Francois Caron from Canada is a favourite, as well as current SCL leader Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and promising underdog Jimmy Paquet (Canada).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the second day in Quebec. The athletes are fighting hard to win this two-day event. The last points of this SCL stage can be won over four outstanding disciplines: Power Stairs, Dumbbell Press, Keg Toss, and finally, the legendary Farmer’s Walk. Who will leave Canada with the yellow ‘Leader Shirt’?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stages 8 and 9 of the SCL are hosted in Vaasa, Finland, taking place over a spectacular two-day event. After 3 wins so far, Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia plans to extend his lead at the top of the table. Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The fight for the Finnish trophy continues. In this unmissable SCL event, the strongmen battle for the win in the Carry and Drag, the Forward Hold, Deadlifting with Cars and the Loading Race. Belsak, Radzikowski and Zageris look good after the first day, but the others haven’t given up yet.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This under 105kg category event is the ultimate preparation for up-and-coming strongman athletes before entering the heavy class. The Lightweight World Championship is a special every year in the SCL calendar as it sees new talents rise and many promising athletes who are gearing up for future tournaments. A total of 25 athletes from 16 different countries make their way to Kokkola, Finland

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Situated in the very heart of the Carpathian Mountains, Sibiu is a Romanian town where the climate is pleasantly mild, offering some of the best weather conditions for a strongman event around Europe. All this, without doubt, set the mood for the high results and showtime vibes in Stage 11 of Strongman Champions League. The competition in Sibiu was organized in six different disciplines

programme.title: Eden Lake
programme.desc: Ein schöner See, herrliche Natur und ein romantisches Stelldichein. Kindergärtnerin Jenny (Kelly Reilly) und ihr Freund Steve (Michael Fassbender) wollen sich und die Ruhe fernab des hektischen Londons allein genießen. Der Haufen lauter Jugendlicher, der neben ihnen Platz nimmt, stört da erheblich. Vor allem der Anführer der Clique Brett (Jack O'Connell) scheint auf Krawall aus zu sein. Erste Konflikte lassen nicht lange auf sich warten. Die Eskalation auch nicht. Brutaler Horror-Thriller, malerisch in der englischen Grafschaft Buckinghamshire inszeniert.

programme.title: Blitz: Cop-Killer vs. Killer-Cop
programme.desc: Die britische Hauptstadt wird von einer Serie von Polizistenmorden erschüttert. Detective Sergeant Tom Brant (Jason Statham) und Detective Inspector Porter Nash (Paddy Considine) sind Teil einer Sonderkommission, die den Täter dingfest machen soll. Auch die Polizistin Elizabeth Falls (Zawe Ashton) gehört zum Team und gerät ins Visier des Cop-Killers. Als Brant die Londoner Unterwelt aufmischt, um den mordenden "Blitz" zu stoppen, macht der rabiate Gesetzeshüter eine überraschende Entdeckung: Er ist dem Tatverdächtigen (Aidan Gillen) bereits zuvor begegnet... - Irish Noir trifft auf britischen Thriller: Das düstere Krimi-Drama von Regisseur Elliott Lester basiert auf Ken Bruens Roman "Blitz".

programme.title: Paranormal Roadtrip
programme.desc: Der Knast, der spukt - Nichts für schwache Nerven! Das Zield der ungewöhnlichen Mission: Die Grenzen der menschlichen Angst auszuloten.

programme.title: Arabellas Crime Time - Verbrechen im Visier
programme.desc: Watch Dogs - Ein Passant beobachtet, wie eine Frau in ein Auto gezerrt wird. Er will helfen, doch der Angreifer zieht eine Waffe und schießt - aber die Pistole hat eine Ladehemmung. "Arabellas Crime Time" zeigt dramatische Geschichten hinter schockierenden Verbrechen, die viral gehen. Von Profi-Überwachungsgeräten bis hin zu Handycams - fast immer schaut jemand zu. Atemberaubende Clips von Entführungen, Einbrüchen, Verfolgungsjagden und anderen Gewaltverbrechen bringen Millionen von Views ein. Doch diese Doku-Serie geht über das spannende Filmmaterial hinaus, um die ganze Geschichte zu erzählen. Präsentiert werden die Fälle von Moderatorin Arabella Kiesbauer.

programme.title: Hour of Power
programme.desc: Warum Gott dich manchmal warten lässt - In die "Stunde der Kraft" sollen Menschen dazu inspiriert werden, in eine liebevolle Beziehung zu Jesus Christus hineinzuwachsen, und zu der Person zu werden, die Gott schuf. Jede Woche gibt es an dieser Stelle neue, inspirierende und ermutigende Gottesdienste, die oft ein Interview mit einer bekannten Persönlichkeit bzw. einem Menschen beinhalten, der etwas Außergewöhnliches erlebt hat.

programme.title: Haus gesucht in Alaska
programme.desc: Pilot's Paradise - Bären, die Vorräte plündern, Elche im Garten und horrende Heizkosten: Wer in Alaska ein Eigenheim kauft, muss sich auf einiges gefasst machen. Dafür wird man im größten US-Bundesstaat umgeben von Bergen und Seen mit grandiosen Aussichten belohnt. Man kann direkt hinterm Haus angeln oder von der Terrasse aus Wildtiere beobachten. Und wenn man die selbst gefangenen Lachse auf den Grill legt, beschwert sich kein Nachbar. Diese Abgeschiedenheit wissen viele Menschen zu schätzen. Und der Immobilienmarkt lockt mit einem breit gefächerten Angebot. Rustikale Blockhütten und schicke Behausungen mit Sauna und Whirlpool: Diese Serie zeigt die gemütlichsten Eigenheime und stellt ihre Käufer vor.

programme.title: Stargate Atlantis
programme.desc: Verwandlung - Das legendäre Atlantis existiert tatsächlich! Ein internationales Team aus Wissenschaftlern und Militärs auf der Erde hat eine sensationelle Entdeckung zu verbuchen: Im ewigen Eis der Antarktis findet es ein Tor zu einer neuen Welt. Durch das neue Stargate, ein Sternentor, gelangt ein Forschertrupp zur Pegasus Galaxie, wo sich die legendäre Stadt Atlantis befinden soll. Die gefährliche Mission führt das Atlantis-Team weit hinein ins Universum - weiter, als jemals zuvor ein Mensch gewesen ist. - Spin-off der Fernsehserie Stargate SG-1, welches ebenso wie das Original von Showrunner Brad Wright erdachte wurde.

programme.title: Hercules
programme.desc: Die Abrechnung - Hercules wird auf eine harte Probe gestellt. Nun, da seine übernatürlichen Kräfte verloren sind, ist der Halbgott dem Zorn seiner Widersacher schutzlos ausgeliefert. Als Strife (Joel Tobeck), der Neffe von Kriegsgott Ares, behauptet, Hercules habe seine Ehefrau Serena ermordet, eskaliert die Situation. Neben feindseligen Göttern hat es jetzt auch ein wütender Mob aus dem Dorf Cyrenia auf den trauernden Witwer abgesehen! Xena, Gabrielle (Renée O'Connor), Iolaus und sogar Zeus (Peter Vere-Jones) stehen Hercules in der schweren Zeit zur Seite, damit die Wahrheit über das perfide Mordkomplott ans Licht kommt.

programme.title: Hercules
programme.desc: Die unterirdische Stadt - Iolaus und seine Gefährtin Moria (Fiona Mogridge) stoßen auf ein düsteres Geheimnis. Offenbar hat der betrügerische Sektenführer Kamaros (Matthew Chamberlain) Männer und Frauen um sich geschart, um für ihn nach Gold zu schürfen. Auch Salmoneus und Iolaus' verschollene Cousine Regina (Amber Sainsbury) sind in den Dunstkreis des manipulativen Gurus geraten. Als herauskommt, dass Kamaros sogar Drogen einsetzt, damit die Gehirnwäsche funktioniert, ziehen Iolaus und Moria alle Register. Sie mischen den Sektenführer und seine Schergen auf und befreien den Untergrundkult aus der Sklaverei.

programme.title: Hercules
programme.desc: Im Namen der Gerechtigkeit - Frankreich, 1789: Die Banditen Robert (Kevin Sorbo) und Jean-Pierre (Michael Hurst) lassen keine Gelegenheit aus, wenn es darum geht, etwas dazu zu verdienen. Auch Francois (Robert Trebor) und dessen Angebetete, die Aristokratin Marie DeValle (Danielle Cormack), geraten ins Visier des gewieften Duos. Aber bei diesem historisch angehauchten Versteckspiel ist nichts, wie es scheint: Denn hinter den Kulissen zieht ein geheimnisvoller Freiheitskämpfer, Deckname "der Fuchs", die Strippen. Als die Tarnung des Phantoms auffliegt, und Marie mit der Guillotine hingerichtet werden soll, schreiten die Gauner zur Tat...

programme.title: Xena
programme.desc: Karmische Katastrophen - Die Kriegerprinzessin Xena (Lucy Lawless) hat böswilligen Göttern und herrschsüchtigen Warlords den Kampf angesagt. In einer antiken Welt voller Mythen und Legenden setzt sich die furchtlose Fighterin für das Gute ein. Zusammen mit ihrer besten Freundin Gabrielle (Renée O'Connor) beschützt Xena die Schwachen und befreit die Unterdrückten. Bei dem Abenteuer, das von Griechenland über Persien bis ins Land der aufgehenden Sonne führt, muss sich Xena oft mit ihrer eigenen Vergangenheit auseinandersetzen. Denn Kriegsgott Ares (Kevin Smith) lässt nichts unversucht, seine einstige Schülerin zurück auf die dunkle Seite zu ziehen. - Zeitloser Fantasy-Klassiker aus den 1990er-Jahren.

programme.title: Spooky Night - Nachts im Horrorladen
programme.desc: Pünktlich zu Halloween haben Bo (Jaiden J. Smith), Carson (Dylan Martin Frankel) und Jake (Donovan Colan) etwas ganz Besonderes vor. Die drei Schulfreunde lassen sich über Nacht in einem "Spirit Halloween"-Shop einsperren! Auch Carsons Schwester Kate (Marissa Reyes) stößt später dazu. Doch das freche Teenie-Abenteuer mutiert schnell zu einem echten Albtraum. Was die Freunde nicht wissen: Der Horrorladen ist total verhext, und zwischen den Grusel-Accessoires lauert ein mies gelaunter Geist. - Das Drehbuch des spaßigen Jugend-Horrorfilms stammt aus der Feder von Filmemacherin Billie Bates.

programme.title: The Intergalactic Adventures of Max Cloud
programme.desc: Brooklyn, 1990: Als Sarah (Isabelle Allen) Videospielverbot für das ganze Wochenende erteilt bekommt, bricht für das Mädchen die Welt zusammen. Doch ehe Sarah sich versieht, findet sie sich in der virtuellen Realität ihres Lieblings-Videospiels wieder. Nun muss die junge Gamerin Seite an Seite mit dem Weltraumhelden Max Cloud (Scott Adkins) und dessen Crew gegen übermächtige Space-Schurken antreten, die in einem intergalaktischen Gefängnis einsitzen. Aber nur, wenn es Sarahs Kumpel Cowboy (Franz Drameh) zuhause an der Konsole gelingt, die schlimmsten Verbrecher des Universums auszuknipsen, hat das Zocker-Girl eine Chance auf Heimkehr. - Sciencefiction-Actionkomödie von Regisseur Martin Owen.

programme.title: X
programme.desc: 1979 plant eine Gruppe junger Filmemacher, einen Sexstreifen in Texas zu drehen. Der Porno trägt den Titel "The Farmer's Daughters", weshalb die Handlung auf einem einsam gelegenen Bauernhof spielt. Als Maxine (Mia Goth), Jackson (Kid Cudi) und die anderen mit den ersten wilden Sexszenen loslegen, ist das Schicksal der jungen Leute bereits besiegelt. Denn was niemand der Filmcrew geahnt hat: Das schrullige Gastgeber-Ehepaar hat auf seine alten Tage eine bizarre Mordlust entwickelt! - Der Independent-Film von Ti West erhielt u.a. Nominierungen für den Chainsaw- und den Saturn Award ("Best Horror Movie").

programme.title: Doctor Who
programme.desc: Tötet den Mond - 2049 steht die Welt kurz davor, den Mond in die Luft zu jagen. Da die Masse des Erdtrabanten stark zugenommen hat, kommt es zu tödlichen Flutwellen. Der Doktor und Clara fliegen mit dem Space Shuttle von Captain Lundvik (Hermione Norris) zum Mond, wobei sie einige erschreckende Entdeckungen machen. Die Astronaut:innen befinden sich auf einer Selbstmordmission: Sie sollen den lästigen Himmelskörper mit Atombomben pulverisieren! Bei näherer Betrachtung kommt zudem heraus, dass es sich beim Mond in Wahrheit um ein gigantisches Ei handelt. Aber welche Kreatur wird hier in Kürze schlüpfen? Und was bedeutet das für die Zukunft der Menschheit?

programme.title: Doctor Who
programme.desc: Die Mumie - Als der Timelord und Clara eine interstellare Zugreise antreten, müssen sie eine Reihe rätselhafter Todesfälle aufklären. Die Passagiere im kosmischen Orient-Express werden von einer unsichtbaren Mumie attackiert. Wer die grausige Kreatur erblickt, stirbt exakt in 66 Sekunden! Der Doktor findet heraus, dass es sich bei der Mumie um eine sagenumwobene Entität handelt, die auch als "Prophezeiung" bezeichnet wird. Weitere Detektivarbeit im Weltraumzug bringt ans Licht, dass die Mumie in Wahrheit ein untoter Soldat aus der Zukunft ist, der zum Morden verdammt wurde und futuristische Technologien einsetzt.

programme.title: 2021 War of the Worlds: Invasion from Mars
programme.desc: Angriff auf die Erde: Als eine feindselige Alien-Zivilisation vom Mars aus den Planeten ansteuert, ist es bereits zu spät. Zunächst wird die internationale Raumstation ISS per Laserstrahl zerstört. Danach ist New York City dran. Die Außerirdischen sind monströse Wesen und verfügen über futuristische Technologien. Während die US-Streitkräfte unter dem Kommando von General Reed (Tom Sizemore) zum Gegenschlag ausholen, suchen Astroforscherin Dr. Allison Fischer (Emily Killian) und ihr Bruder Henry (Anthony Jensen) nach alternativen Methoden der Alienbekämpfung. - Science-Fiction-Endzeit-Thriller mit jeder Menge CGI. Regie führte Mario N. Bonassin. Das Drehbuch stammt von Joe Roche.

programme.title: Der City Hai
programme.desc: Mark Kaminsky (Arnold Schwarzenegger) fristet sein Dasein als Sheriff in einer Kleinstadt, seit er sich mit seiner brutalen Art als FBI-Agent selbst ins Aus geschossen hat. Doch dann braucht ihn Chicago: Die Mafia hat überhandgenommen und sogar den Sohn seines früheren Kollegen Shannon (Darren McGavin) getötet. Jetzt darf Kaminsky wieder ran. - Der Film überrascht mit kleinen Ähnlichkeiten und Anspielungen auf andere Schwarzenegger-Filme: zum Beispiel trägt Baker, der Charakter von Robert Davi, in "Der City Hai" die Sonnenbrille, die Schwarzenegger in "Terminator" aufhatte. Auch das typische Schwarzenegger-"I'll be back" ist wieder enthalten.

programme.title: D-Tox - Im Auge der Angst
programme.desc: FBI-Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) ist der Alkoholsucht verfallen. Der Grund? Ein Serienkiller hat mehrere Kollegen, und nun auch Jakes Freundin, bestialisch ermordet. Der Versuch, die traumatischen Ereignisse zu verarbeiten, führt Malloy schließlich in eine Nervenheilanstalt für Beamte in Wyoming. Dort bekommt er seelische Unterstützung von Dr. John Mitchell (Kris Kristofferson) und Psychotherapeutin Jenny Munroe (Polly Walker). Doch als der Gebäudekomplex durch einen Schneesturm von der Außenwelt abgeschnitten wird, gehen die Morde plötzlich innerhalb der Klinik weiter. - Psychothriller mit Sylvester Stallone als (Anti-)Held in der Hauptrolle. Der Film basiert auf dem Roman ...

programme.title: The Intergalactic Adventures of Max Cloud
programme.desc: Brooklyn, 1990: Als Sarah (Isabelle Allen) Videospielverbot für das ganze Wochenende erteilt bekommt, bricht für das Mädchen die Welt zusammen. Doch ehe Sarah sich versieht, findet sie sich in der virtuellen Realität ihres Lieblings-Videospiels wieder. Nun muss die junge Gamerin Seite an Seite mit dem Weltraumhelden Max Cloud (Scott Adkins) und dessen Crew gegen übermächtige Space-Schurken antreten, die in einem intergalaktischen Gefängnis einsitzen. Aber nur, wenn es Sarahs Kumpel Cowboy (Franz Drameh) zuhause an der Konsole gelingt, die schlimmsten Verbrecher des Universums auszuknipsen, hat das Zocker-Girl eine Chance auf Heimkehr. - Sciencefiction-Actionkomödie von Regisseur Martin Owen.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: The Emmy Award-winning THE AMAZING RACE returns with the first reality showdown among some of the most memorable and competitive players from THE AMAZING RACE, SURVIVOR and BIG BROTHER.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.sub-title: Knock the Newbie Out of Us
programme.desc: Racers have a big decision to make when they face a surprise double U-turn in Laos.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: Teams travel to Vietnam where they must master synchronized dancing, karaoke singing and fishing for prawns.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.sub-title: I Took Out a Polar Bear
programme.desc: Enemies are made when one team steals another team's taxi in Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.sub-title: I'm a Bird, I'm a Plane, I'm on The Amazing Race!
programme.desc: Teams take a leap of faith when choosing which detour challenge to take on. And, a split-second decision may make or break one team's life.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: Teams must drum up enough strength for an intense head-to-head battle before checking into the mat.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: The Teams travel to Switzerland where they free-fall over 400 feet into the Gletscherschlucht Glacier Gorge.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.sub-title: You're The Apple In My Eye
programme.desc: While in Switzerland, teams are surprised with the first ever public U-turn vote, where racers have to vote in front of each other.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: Teams take a bumpy ride in Split, Croatia and try not to get tongue-twisted reciting poetry while in motion.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: The final five teams try not to crack while transporting eggs across town by bicycle in the Netherlands.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.sub-title: This One is For One Million Dollars
programme.desc: With the $1 million on the line, the final four teams race through London. The team to cross the finish line first will be crowned the winners!

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: "The Amazing Race" celebrates travelling one million miles around the world when the 32nd race kicks off from Los Angeles.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.sub-title: Red Lipstick Is Not My Color
programme.desc: Teams race through Bogotá, Colombia, where they encounter the "Yield," which gives them the power to stop another team's race for a designated amount of time.

programme.title: The Amazing Race
programme.desc: Teams are in Manaus, Brazil, where they have big decisions to make when they encounter the first U-turn of the race.

programme.desc: Abram struggles with insecurity over his on-and-off relationship with Cara Maria, while Paula and Dunbar seem to be getting over their issues-for now. And physical injuries put not one, but two teams, in jeopardy of going home.

programme.title: Teleshopping
टेलीशॉपिंग
டெலிஷாப்பிங்
టెలీషాపింగ్
programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: Jadui Nagari
जादुई नगरी
ஜாதுய் நகரி
జాదుయి నగరి
programme.desc: A collection of animated stories that apprise the viewers of valuable life lessons and inculcate moral values and sentiments.
एनिमेटेड कहानियों का एक संग्रह जो दर्शकों को मूल्यवान जीवन के सबक से अवगत कराता है और नैतिक मूल्यों और भावनाओं को विकसित करता है।
மதிப்புமிக்க வாழ்க்கை பாடங்களை மக்களுக்கு தெரிவிக்கும் மற்றும் தார்மீக மதிப்புகளை வளர்க்கும் அனிமேஷன் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு.
వీక్షకులకు విలువైన జీవిత పాఠాలను తెలియజేస్తూ, నైతిక విలువలను, సద్భావనలను పెంపొందించే యానిమేటెడ్ కథల సమాహారం.

programme.title: Daravni Kahaniya
डरावनी कहानियाँ
தராவ்னி கஹானியா
దారావిని కహానియా
programme.desc: A selection of scary, creepy and thrilling stories featuring various characters from different backgrounds is presented.
विभिन्न पृष्ठभूमियों के विभिन्न पात्रों पर आधारित डरावनी, खौफनाक और रोमांचक कहानियों का संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।
வெவ்வேறு பின்னணிகளைச் சேர்ந்த பல்வேறு கதாபாத்திரங்களைக் கொண்ட பயங்கரமான மற்றும் சிலிர்ப்பூட்டும் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு.
విభిన్న నేపథ్యాల నుండి వచ్చిన వివిధ పాత్రలతో కూడిన భయానక, గగుర్పాటు కలిగించే, ఉత్కంఠభరితమైన కథల ప్రసారం.

programme.title: Maskari
मस्करी
மஸ்கரி
మస్కరి
programme.desc: A confident and fun-loving young man gets into comedic situations as he lives his life and spends time with his family and friends.
एक आत्मविश्वासी और मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला युवक अपनी जिंदगी जीते हुए और अपने परिवार और दोस्तों के साथ समय बिताते हुए हास्यपूर्ण स्थितियों में फंस जाता है।
தனது வாழ்க்கையை வாழும்போதும், குடும்பம்-நண்பர்களுடன் நேரத்தை செலவிடும்போதும் நகைச்சுவை சூழ்நிலைகளில் சிக்கும் இளைஞர்.
సరదాగా ఉండే ఒక యువకుడు, తన కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో, స్నేహితులతో సమయం గడిపే క్రమంలో హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలో చిక్కుకుంటాడు.

వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.title: Maskari
मस्करी
மஸ்கரி
మస్కరి
programme.desc: A confident and fun-loving young man gets into comedic situations as he lives his life and spends time with his family and friends.
एक आत्मविश्वासी और मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला युवक अपनी जिंदगी जीते हुए और अपने परिवार और दोस्तों के साथ समय बिताते हुए हास्यपूर्ण स्थितियों में फंस जाता है।
தனது வாழ்க்கையை வாழும்போதும், குடும்பம்-நண்பர்களுடன் நேரத்தை செலவிடும்போதும் நகைச்சுவை சூழ்நிலைகளில் சிக்கும் இளைஞர்.
సరదాగా ఉండే ఒక యువకుడు, తన కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో, స్నేహితులతో సమయం గడిపే క్రమంలో హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలో చిక్కుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: Movie

సినిమాలలో ఉత్తమమైనది.

programme.title: BakLol
बकलोल
பாக்லோக்
బక్లోల్
programme.desc: Individuals from different walks of life respond to problems and situations in a comedic way, creating humorous experiences.
विभिन्न क्षेत्रों के व्यक्ति समस्याओं और स्थितियों पर हास्यपूर्ण तरीके से प्रतिक्रिया देते हैं, जिससे हास्यपूर्ण परिस्थितियाँ उत्पन्न होती हैं।
பல்வேறு நபர்கள் தங்களின் நகைச்சுவைகளுடன் ஒருவருக்கு ஒருவர் உதவுவதன் மூலம் அவர்களின் அன்றாட பிரச்சனைகளை சமாளிக்கின்றனர்.
వివిధ వ్యక్తులు ఒకరికొకరు ఉల్లాసమైన రీతిలో సహాయం చేసుకోవడం ద్వారా వారి రోజువారీ సమస్యలను పరిష్కరించుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Super Comedy Express
सुपर कॉमेडी एक्सप्रेस
சூப்பர் காமெடி எக்ஸ்பிரஸ்
సూపర్ కామెడీ ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్
programme.desc: Renowned comedians from the Marathi entertainment industry perform various stand-up acts and skits to entertain the audience.
मराठी मनोरंजन उद्योग के प्रसिद्ध हास्य कलाकार दर्शकों का मनोरंजन करने के लिए विभिन्न स्टैंड-अप एक्ट और स्किट करते हैं।
பார்வையாளர்களை மகிழ்விப்பதற்காக மராத்தி நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு ஸ்டாண்ட்-அப் நிகழ்ச்சிகளை நிகழ்த்துகிறார்கள்.
మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

programme.title: Yaar Mera Superstar
यार मेरा सूपरस्टार
யார் மேரா சூப்பர்ஸ்டார்
యార్ మేరా సూపర్‌స్టార్
programme.desc: The host engages in hilarious conversations with actors and celebrities about their success stories and incidents that offer moral lessons from their lives.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता, अभिनेताओं और मशहूर हस्तियों के साथ उनकी सफलता की कहानियों और उनके जीवन से नैतिक शिक्षा प्रदान करने वाली घटनाओं के बारे में हास्यपूर्ण बातचीत करते हैं।
நடிகர்கள்-பிரபலங்களுடன் அவர்களின் வெற்றிக் கதைகள் மற்றும் வாழ்க்கையில் நடந்த சம்பவங்கள் குறித்து பேசும் தொகுப்பாளர்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత పలువురు నటులు, సెలబ్రిటీలతో వారి విజయాలు, తమ జీవితంలో నైతిక పాఠాలు నేర్చుకున్న సంఘటనల గురించి సంభాషిస్తారు.

వివిధ వ్యక్తులు ఒకరికొకరు ఉల్లాసమైన రీతిలో సహాయం చేసుకోవడం ద్వారా వారి రోజువారీ సమస్యలను పరిష్కరించుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Super Comedy Express
सुपर कॉमेडी एक्सप्रेस
சூப்பர் காமெடி எக்ஸ்பிரஸ்
సూపర్ కామెడీ ఎక్స్‌ప్రెస్
programme.desc: Renowned comedians from the Marathi entertainment industry perform various stand-up acts and skits to entertain the audience.
मराठी मनोरंजन उद्योग के प्रसिद्ध हास्य कलाकार दर्शकों का मनोरंजन करने के लिए विभिन्न स्टैंड-अप एक्ट और स्किट करते हैं।
பார்வையாளர்களை மகிழ்விப்பதற்காக மராத்தி நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு ஸ்டாண்ட்-அப் நிகழ்ச்சிகளை நிகழ்த்துகிறார்கள்.
మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

programme.title: Rishto Ki Dor
रिश्तो की डोर
ரிஷ்தோ கி தோர்
రిష్తో కి డోర్
programme.desc: A collection of stories from people's daily lives, which teaches valuable lessons about being a good human being, is presented.
लोगों के दैनिक जीवन की कहानियों का संग्रह प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, जो एक अच्छे इंसान बनने के लिए अच्छे सबक सिखाता है।
மதிப்புமிக்க பாடங்களைக் கற்பிக்கும், மக்களின் அன்றாட வாழ்க்கையிலிருந்து வரும் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு வழங்கப்படுகிறது.
తల్లిదండ్రుల మరణం తరువాత తన ముగ్గురు చెల్లెళ్లను చూసుకోవడానికి చాలా కష్టపడుతున్న సుహాస్ చాలా సవాళ్లను ఎదుర్కొంటాడు.

programme.title: Teleshopping
टेलीशॉपिंग
டெலிஷாப்பிங்
టెలీషాపింగ్
programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.

programme.title: Jadui Nagari
जादुई नगरी
ஜாதுய் நகரி
జాదుయి నగరి
programme.desc: A collection of animated stories that apprise the viewers of valuable life lessons and inculcate moral values and sentiments.
एनिमेटेड कहानियों का एक संग्रह जो दर्शकों को मूल्यवान जीवन के सबक से अवगत कराता है और नैतिक मूल्यों और भावनाओं को विकसित करता है।
மதிப்புமிக்க வாழ்க்கை பாடங்களை மக்களுக்கு தெரிவிக்கும் மற்றும் தார்மீக மதிப்புகளை வளர்க்கும் அனிமேஷன் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு.
వీక్షకులకు విలువైన జీవిత పాఠాలను తెలియజేస్తూ, నైతిక విలువలను, సద్భావనలను పెంపొందించే యానిమేటెడ్ కథల సమాహారం.

వీక్షకులకు విలువైన జీవిత పాఠాలను తెలియజేస్తూ, నైతిక విలువలను, సద్భావనలను పెంపొందించే యానిమేటెడ్ కథల సమాహారం.

programme.title: Daravni Kahaniya
डरावनी कहानियाँ
தராவ்னி கஹானியா
దారావిని కహానియా
programme.desc: A selection of scary, creepy and thrilling stories featuring various characters from different backgrounds is presented.
विभिन्न पृष्ठभूमियों के विभिन्न पात्रों पर आधारित डरावनी, खौफनाक और रोमांचक कहानियों का संकलन प्रस्तुत किया जाता है।
வெவ்வேறு பின்னணிகளைச் சேர்ந்த பல்வேறு கதாபாத்திரங்களைக் கொண்ட பயங்கரமான மற்றும் சிலிர்ப்பூட்டும் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு.
విభిన్న నేపథ్యాల నుండి వచ్చిన వివిధ పాత్రలతో కూడిన భయానక, గగుర్పాటు కలిగించే, ఉత్కంఠభరితమైన కథల ప్రసారం.

programme.title: Maskari
मस्करी
மஸ்கரி
మస్కరి
programme.desc: A confident and fun-loving young man gets into comedic situations as he lives his life and spends time with his family and friends.
एक आत्मविश्वासी और मौज-मस्ती पसंद करने वाला युवक अपनी जिंदगी जीते हुए और अपने परिवार और दोस्तों के साथ समय बिताते हुए हास्यपूर्ण स्थितियों में फंस जाता है।
தனது வாழ்க்கையை வாழும்போதும், குடும்பம்-நண்பர்களுடன் நேரத்தை செலவிடும்போதும் நகைச்சுவை சூழ்நிலைகளில் சிக்கும் இளைஞர்.
సరదాగా ఉండే ఒక యువకుడు, తన కుటుంబ సభ్యులతో, స్నేహితులతో సమయం గడిపే క్రమంలో హాస్యభరితమైన పరిస్థితులలో చిక్కుకుంటాడు.

programme.title: Teleshopping
टेलीशॉपिंग
டெலிஷாப்பிங்
టెలీషాపింగ్
programme.desc: The host showcases the features of a variety of products manufactured by renowned brands that can be purchased from the comfort of one's home.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता प्रसिद्ध ब्रांडों द्वारा निर्मित विभिन्न प्रकार के उत्पादों की विशेषताओं को पेश करते हैं, जिन्हें घर बैठे खरीदा जा सकता है।
பிரபல பிராண்டுகள் தயாரிக்கும், வீட்டிலிருந்தே வாங்கக்கூடிய பல்வேறு வகையான தயாரிப்புகளின் அம்சங்களை பற்றி அறிக.
వ్యాఖ్యాత ఇంటినుండే సౌకర్యంగా కొనుగోలు చేయగల వివిధ రకాల ప్రముఖ బ్రాండెడ్ ఉత్పత్తుల ప్రత్యేకతలు, ఇతర వివరాలను తెలుపుతారు.

programme.desc: Renowned comedians from the Marathi entertainment industry perform various stand-up acts and skits to entertain the audience.
मराठी मनोरंजन उद्योग के प्रसिद्ध हास्य कलाकार दर्शकों का मनोरंजन करने के लिए विभिन्न स्टैंड-अप एक्ट और स्किट करते हैं।
பார்வையாளர்களை மகிழ்விப்பதற்காக மராத்தி நகைச்சுவை நடிகர்கள் பல்வேறு ஸ்டாண்ட்-அப் நிகழ்ச்சிகளை நிகழ்த்துகிறார்கள்.
మరాఠీ వినోద పరిశ్రమకు చెందిన హాస్యనటులు స్టాండ్-అప్ యాక్టింగ్‌లు, స్కిట్‌లను ప్రదర్శిస్తూ ప్రేక్షకులను అలరిస్తారు.

programme.title: Yaar Mera Superstar
यार मेरा सूपरस्टार
யார் மேரா சூப்பர்ஸ்டார்
యార్ మేరా సూపర్‌స్టార్
programme.desc: The host engages in hilarious conversations with actors and celebrities about their success stories and incidents that offer moral lessons from their lives.
प्रस्तुतकर्ता, अभिनेताओं और मशहूर हस्तियों के साथ उनकी सफलता की कहानियों और उनके जीवन से नैतिक शिक्षा प्रदान करने वाली घटनाओं के बारे में हास्यपूर्ण बातचीत करते हैं।
நடிகர்கள்-பிரபலங்களுடன் அவர்களின் வெற்றிக் கதைகள் மற்றும் வாழ்க்கையில் நடந்த சம்பவங்கள் குறித்து பேசும் தொகுப்பாளர்.
వ్యాఖ్యాత పలువురు నటులు, సెలబ్రిటీలతో వారి విజయాలు, తమ జీవితంలో నైతిక పాఠాలు నేర్చుకున్న సంఘటనల గురించి సంభాషిస్తారు.

programme.title: Mridul Ki Duniya
मृदुल की दुनिया
ம்ருதுல் கி துனியா
మృదుల్ కి దునియా
programme.desc: Living with their stern mother and frugal father, Mridul and his brother Nitin devise plans to obtain some extra cash and get into amusing mishaps along the way.
अपनी सख्त मां और मितव्ययी पिता के साथ रहते हुए, मृदुल और उसका भाई नितिन कुछ अतिरिक्त नकदी प्राप्त करने की योजना बनाते हैं और इस दौरान मनोरंजक दुर्घटनाओं के कारण बनते हैं।
மிருதுலும் அவரது சகோதரர் நிதினும் பணம் சம்பாதிக்கவும், விபத்துக்களில் சிக்கிக் கொள்ளவும் திட்டங்களை வகுக்கிறார்கள்.
పిసినారి తండ్రి, తల్లితో కలిసుంటున్న మృదుల్, అతడి సోదరుడు నితిన్ డబ్బు పొందే క్రమంలో సరదా పరిస్థితుల్లో చిక్కుకుంటారు.

programme.title: Rishto Ki Dor
रिश्तो की डोर
ரிஷ்தோ கி தோர்
రిష్తో కి డోర్
programme.desc: A collection of stories from people's daily lives, which teaches valuable lessons about being a good human being, is presented.
लोगों के दैनिक जीवन की कहानियों का संग्रह प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, जो एक अच्छे इंसान बनने के लिए अच्छे सबक सिखाता है।
மதிப்புமிக்க பாடங்களைக் கற்பிக்கும், மக்களின் அன்றாட வாழ்க்கையிலிருந்து வரும் கதைகளின் தொகுப்பு வழங்கப்படுகிறது.
తల్లిదండ్రుల మరణం తరువాత తన ముగ్గురు చెల్లెళ్లను చూసుకోవడానికి చాలా కష్టపడుతున్న సుహాస్ చాలా సవాళ్లను ఎదుర్కొంటాడు.

programme.title: Teleshopping
टेलीशॉपिंग
டெலிஷாப்பிங்
